text:
marco: quick heads-up — when previewing the cost card for the routing rollout I saw negative cache savings on tenant X. rolling this tomorrow so want quick triage :eyes:
anya: rechecked, looks like prefetch credits + fallback model charge both applied. maybe we count prefetched tokens on original model AND on fallback when route changes mid-execution.
sam: can you paste the econ-event? I need route_id and model_variant in the event to debug.
marco: snippet below from query sample (redacted project)
```json
{"route":"search_summarize","route_id":42,"model":"gpt-small-q4","tokens":120,"prefetch":true,"fallback_to":"gpt-medium"}
```
chen: repro'd locally. bug is in attribution: CacheAllocator marks tokens as 'prefetch_credited' then Router emits a 'reroute' event that re-attributes to fallback; both flow into the per-invocation sum.
jess: we hit this earlier but had a different symptom. short-term UI fix: show a 'pending credit reconciliation' flag on any negative-savings rows and hide negative percent until backfill runs.
anya: long-term fix should be in econ pipeline: make the event model idempotent by adding a unique prefetch_id and dedupe on that. also add route_origin and model_chain to events.
sam: adding fields is fine but telemetry bandwidth is a concern. can we compress with proto v2 and only send route_origin for reroutes?
kal: from platform side: adding fields is simple (router already knows them). bigger concern is consumers of the stream — we need schema migration plan. prefer additive optional fields, feature gate for canary tenants.
marco: plan for tomorrow: 1) push UI flag via console hotfix (jess) 2) deploy a small schema-add to router events behind gate (kal) 3) run a reconciliation job that backfills negatives for last 48hr (chen)
jess: I'll open a tiny PR to change the cost card to show blue warning pill and tooltip: "Pending reconciliation — values may be double-counted during active rollouts". Will also add a link to the runbook.
sam: for the SDK/API: need to decide whether per-invocation receipts include final_model and model_chain. that matters for per-model unit economics. cc @kal
kal: agree we should include final_model in receipts. let's make that v0.9 of the internal econ spec. will draft today.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for search-service at 2024-06-15T02:30Z :rocket: (jobs/92345)
marco: ok good. after canary, let's run the reconcile and then unflag UX if clean. thanks all.
chen: leaving a quick grep command to find affected invocations:
```bash
psql -c "select invocation_id from econ_events where prefetch=true and fallback_model is not null and timestamp > now() - interval '48 hours' limit 200;"
```
anya: ticket created: PLAT-1319 "negative cache savings during model reroutes" with checklist and priority=p1.
marco: solid. ping me if you need support during deploy window.
